summary: Grifols S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting outcomes of its Ordinary General Shareholders' Meeting held 18 June 2026. The meeting approved the company’s annual accounts, a preferred dividend of EUR 0.01 per Class B share, and an ordinary dividend totaling EUR 56,065,663 against FY2025 results, both payable 2 July 2026. Item eleventh of the agenda did not pass. The Board re-elected two directors. This is a routine report on shareholder meeting results and dividend distributions, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains no transaction terms, premium, or strategic corporate action.
